result.title: DepthTile: Depth-Guided Existing-Image Self-Tiling with Input-Side Tileability Assessment
result.summary: Existing-image self-tiling aims to transform a given image into a seamlessly repeatable tile while preserving its original semantics and local details. This task requires weak editing to retain the source but leave periodic seams, whereas strong editing improves tileability at the large risk of content drift.Existing diffusion-based tiling pipelines alleviate boundary discontinuities, yet lack awareness of which regions are geometrically important to preserve. In this work, we propose DepthTile, a depth-guided self-tiling method whose generation module requires no retraining of the diffusion backbone. It converts monocular depth into a spatial preservation prior and integrates it into the timestep-dependent masking mechanism of Tiled Diffusion. DepthTile converts depth into a spatial editability map and fuses it with the differential diffusion mask. This strengthens source preservation in near-field regions indicated by the monocular depth prior while retaining editing flexibility near compatible background boundaries. To access when self-tiling is feasible, we introduce the Self-Tiling Ability Score (STAS), a lightweight input-side predictor based on RGB, gradient, depth, and depth-gradient cues. On a 335-image benchmark, relative to the default Tiled Diffusion pipeline, DepthTile reduces MAE, LPIPS, and Tiling Score by 12.8%, 26.7%, and 8.4%, respectively. STAS reliably enables difficulty-aware analysis and further supports compatibility-aware pairwise image tiling.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DepthTile，用单目深度构造空间保持先验并融入 Tiled Diffusion 的时间步掩码，实现输入图像的自铺贴，另给出输入侧难度评分 STAS。
